arxiv-1807-10224.title: Low- and high-energy phenomenology of a doubly charged scalar Preprint: PSI-PR-18-08, ZU-TH-28/18
arxiv-1807-10224.creator: Andreas Crivellin, Margherita Ghezzi, Luca Panizzi, Giovanni Marco Pruna, Adrian Signer
arxiv-1807-10224.description: Abstract We explore the phenomenology of an S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) SU(2) -singlet doubly charged scalar at the high and low energy frontier. Such a particle is predicted in different new physics models, like left-right symmetric models or the Zee–Babu model.

arxiv-2104-13169.title: The JSNS 2 Detector Journal: Journal of Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research A
arxiv-2104-13169.creator: S. Ajimura, M. Botran, J. H. Choi, J. W. Choi, M. K. Cheoun, T. Dodo, H. Furuta, J. Goh, K. Haga, M. Harada, S. Hasegawa, Y. Hino, T. Hiraiwa, H. I. Jang, J. S. Jang, M. C. Jang, H. Jeon, S. Jeon, K. K. Joo, J. R. Jordan, D. E. Jung, S. K. Kang, Y. Kasugai, T. Kawasaki, E. J. Kim, J. Y. Kim, S. B. K
arxiv-2104-13169.description: Abstract The JSNS 2 (J-PARC Sterile Neutrino Search at J-PARC Spallation Neutron Source) experiment aims to search for oscillations involving a sterile neutrino in the eV 2 mass-splitting range. The experiment will search for the appearance of electron antineutrinos oscillated from muon antineutrinos. The electron antineutrinos are detected via the inverse beta decay process using a liquid scintillator detector.

arxiv-2105-06939.title: Massless Preheating and Electroweak Vacuum Metastability
arxiv-2105-06939.creator: Jeff Kost, Chang Sub Shin, Takahiro Terada
arxiv-2105-06939.description: Abstract Current measurements of Standard Model parameters suggest that the electroweak vacuum is metastable. This metastability has important cosmological implications because large fluctuations in the Higgs field could trigger vacuum decay in the early universe. For the false vacuum to survive, interactions which stabilize the Higgs during inflation— e.g. , inflaton-Higgs interactions or non-minimal couplings to gravity—are typically necessary.

arxiv-2106-06965.title: Contrastive Attention for Automatic Chest X-ray Report Generation
arxiv-2106-06965.creator: Fenglin Liu, Changchang Yin, Xian Wu, Shen Ge, Ping Zhang, Yuexian Zou, Xu Sun
arxiv-2106-06965.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Fenglin Liu, Changchang Yin, Xian Wu, Shen Ge, Ping Zhang, Yuexian Zou, Xu Sun. Recently, chest X-ray report generation, which aims to automatically generate descriptions of given chest X-ray images, has received growing research interests. The key challenge of chest X-ray report generation is to accurately capture and describe the abnormal regions. In most cases, the normal regions dominate the entire chest X-ray image, and the corresponding descriptions of these normal regions dominate the final report.

arxiv-2112-02386.title: Restricted phase space thermodynamics for AdS black holes via holography
arxiv-2112-02386.creator: Zeyuan Gao, Liu Zhao
arxiv-2112-02386.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Zeyuan Gao, Liu Zhao. A new formalism for thermodynamics of AdS black holes called the restricted phase space thermodynamics (RPST) is proposed. The construction is based on top of Visser’s holographic thermodynamics, but with the AdS radius fixed as a constant. Thus the RPST is free of the ( P , V ) (P,V) variables but inherits the central charge and chemical potential as a new pair of conjugate thermodynamic variables.

arxiv-2209-12340.title: Solving Seismic Wave Equations on Variable Velocity Models with Fourier Neural Operator
arxiv-2209-12340.creator: Bian Li, Hanchen Wang, Shihang Feng, Xiu Yang, Youzuo Lin
arxiv-2209-12340.description: Abstract In the study of subsurface seismic imaging, solving the acoustic wave equation is a pivotal component in existing models. The advancement of deep learning enables solving partial differential equations, including wave equations, by applying neural networks to identify the mapping between the inputs and the solution.

arxiv-2210-14476.title: Sinusoidal Frequency Estimation by Gradient Descent
arxiv-2210-14476.creator: Ben Hayes, Charalampos Saitis, György Fazekas
arxiv-2210-14476.description: Abstract Sinusoidal parameter estimation is a fundamental task in applications from spectral analysis to time-series forecasting. Estimating the sinusoidal frequency parameter by gradient descent is, however, often impossible as the error function is non-convex and densely populated with local minima.

arxiv-2211-02359.title: HUPD-2211 Study of weak-basis invariants in the universal seesaw model using Hilbert series
arxiv-2211-02359.creator: Albertus Hariwangsa Panuluh 1,2 and Takuya Morozumi 1,3
arxiv-2211-02359.description: Abstract Universal Seesaw Model is a model which explains the mass hierarchy of the quark sector. This model introduces vector-like quarks. The top quark mass is generated in the electroweak scale and the other quark mass is generated using a seesaw-like mechanism. The invariant theory helps construct a weak-basis invariant.

arxiv-2307-13894.title: AI4GCC - Team: Below Sea Level Critiques and Improvements
arxiv-2307-13894.creator: Bram Renting*, Phillip Wozny*, Robert Loftin, Claudia Wieners, Erman Acar
arxiv-2307-13894.description: Abstract We present a critical analysis of the simulation framework RICE-N, an integrated assessment model (IAM) for evaluating the impacts of climate change on the economy. We identify key issues with RICE-N, including action masking and irrelevant actions, and suggest improvements such as utilizing tariff revenue and penalizing overproduction.

arxiv-2405-05166.title: Riemann problem for polychromatic soliton gases: a testbed for the spectral kinetic theory
arxiv-2405-05166.creator: Thibault Congy, Henry T. Carr, Giacomo Roberti & Gennady A. El
arxiv-2405-05166.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Thibault Congy, Henry T. Carr, Giacomo Roberti & Gennady A. El. We use Riemann problem for soliton gas as a benchmark for a detailed numerical validation of the spectral kinetic theory for the Korteweg-de Vries (KdV) and the focusing nonlinear Schrödinger (fNLS) equations.

arxiv-2410-05322.title: Noise Crystallization and Liquid Noise: Zero-shot Video Generation using Image Diffusion Models
arxiv-2410-05322.creator: Muhammad Haaris Khan, Hadrien Reynaud, Bernhard Kainz
arxiv-2410-05322.description: Abstract Although powerful for image generation, consistent and controllable video is a longstanding problem for diffusion models. Video models require extensive training and computational resources, leading to high costs and large environmental impacts. Moreover, video models currently offer limited control of the output motion.

arxiv-2601-20473.title: A Quiescent Galaxy in a Gas-Rich Cosmic Web Node at z ∼ \sim 3
arxiv-2601-20473.creator: Weichen Wang ,, Sebastiano Cantalupo, Marta Galbiati, Andrea Travascio, Antonio Pensabene, Charles C. Steidel, Gabriele Pezzulli, Bingjie Wang, Xiaohan Wang, Rajeshwari Dutta, Titouan Lazeyras, Nicolas Ledos, Huiyang Mao, Giada Quadri
arxiv-2601-20473.description: Abstract Recent JWST observations have unveiled a large number of quiescent galaxies at z ≳ 3 z\gtrsim 3 , bringing potential challenges to current galaxy formation models. Since star formation is expected to be fed by external gas accretion, the knowledge about the circumgalactic media (CGM) of these galaxies is essential to understanding how they quench.

pmc-11389206.title: Targeting NPM1 inhibits proliferation and promotes apoptosis of hepatic progenitor cells via suppression of mTOR signalling pathway
pmc-11389206.creator: Ping Wang, Min Wang, Lin Liu, Hongyi Li, Helin Liu, Jiangbo Ren, Tianhui Liu, Min Cong, Zhijun Zhu, Xinyan Zhao, Liying Sun, Jidong Jia

pmc-11466833.title: POLCAM: instant molecular orientation microscopy for the life sciences
pmc-11466833.creator: Ezra Bruggeman, Oumeng Zhang, Lisa-Maria Needham, Markus Körbel, Sam Daly, Matthew Cheetham, Ruby Peters, Tingting Wu, Andrey S. Klymchenko, Simon J. Davis, Ewa K. Paluch, David Klenerman, Matthew D. Lew, Kevin O’Holleran, Steven F. Lee
pmc-11466833.description: Current methods for single-molecule orientation localization microscopy (SMOLM) require optical setups and algorithms that can be prohibitively slow and complex, limiting widespread adoption for biological applications. We present POLCAM, a simplified SMOLM method based on polarized detection using a polarization camera, which can be easily implemented on any wide-field fluorescence microscope.

pmc-11618474.title: Insights into the anomalous hardness of the tantalum carbides from dislocation mobility
pmc-11618474.creator: Brennan R. Watkins, C. Haas Blacksher, Alyssa Stubbers, Gregory B. Thompson, Christopher R. Weinberger
pmc-11618474.description: The tantalum carbides, TaCx, have been repeatedly shown to harden dramatically with some loss of carbon content, then soften with further decarburization. First observed in 1963, this anomalous hardness behavior has been reproduced for decades without satisfactory explanation. Prior attempts to characterize this phenomenon using elastic stiffnesses have failed to reproduce the anomalous hardness behavior.

pmc-11629009.title: Unlocking the door to supportive housing: addressing the challenge of post-discharge transitions in safety-net psychiatric care

pmc-12574085.title: Using the socioecological model to guide service delivery improvements to the prison needle exchange program in Canada: insights from multi-level stakeholders
pmc-12574085.creator: Nadine Kronfli, Lise Lafferty, Frederic Leone, Mark Stoové, Behzad Hajarizadeh, Andrew R Lloyd, Frederick L Altice
pmc-12574085.description: BackgroundIn 2018–2019, Canada introduced a Prison Needle Exchange Program (PNEP) across nine federal facilities to mitigate the harms associated with drug injection among incarcerated people. However, program uptake has been limited. We explored the barriers and facilitators to improving PNEP services among key stakeholders in prison.

pmc-12859371.title: AI-powered finite element analysis for predicting fracture patterns in endodontically treated teeth restored with posts
pmc-12859371.creator: Divya Batra, Priyatam Maruti Karade, Chirag R Vaniya, Ataul Hafeez Imran, Mohd Ahmed Ali Khan, Ishita Ghosh
pmc-12859371.description: Endodontically treated teeth (ETT) are prone to fracture due to structural compromise and conventional finite element analysis (FEA) has limitations in accurately predicting fracture behavior. Therefore, it is of interest to evaluate an artificial intelligence (AI)-enhanced FEA model for predicting fracture patterns in ETT restored with fiberglass, carbon fiber, zirconia and cast metal posts.

pmc-12932775.title: Effects of One Season of Rugby on the Neurological Integrity of Male Adolescent Players
pmc-12932775.creator: Stefan Henley, Nicole Spriggs, Natalia Kabaliuk, Danyon Stitt, Annette Swale, Congyu Xu, Kevin Mangan, Mike Hamlin, Rich Masters, Tracy Melzer, Arindam Basu, Tim Anderson, Deborah Snell, Adrian Clark, Keith Alexander, Samantha Holdsworth, Nick Draper
pmc-12932775.description: BackgroundRugby union is a popular contact sport during which high impact collisions frequently occur. There is concern for the overall brain health of those playing the game, as concussion is a potential outcome of high impact collisions. Repeated sub-concussive collisions may compromise rugby players’ neurological integrity, but little is known about the effects on young brains.

pmc-13252980.title: Italy’s Landmark Obesity Law: The Long Road from Science to Policy
pmc-13252980.creator: Michele O. Carruba, Andrea Lenzi, Pietro Paganini, Federico Serra, Enzo Nisoli
pmc-13252980.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). stablishes a national framework for prevention, treatment, and long-term care [2, 3]. Italy is, to our knowledge, the first country to enshrine in national legislation a comprehensive, disease-centred framing of obesity within a structured prevention and care mandate [2]. Specifically, Article 1 recognises obesity as a chronic disease and a priority for clinical interventions and public health strategies, moving beyond its historical framing as merely a risk factor for cardiometabolic complications [2].

pmc-13407423.title: Serum FGF-23 and α-Klotho Levels in Prolactinoma and Non-Tumoral Hyperprolactinemia: An Exploratory Cross-Sectional Comparative Study
pmc-13407423.creator: Abdullah Altuğ, Fatma Zehra Yıldırım Arı, Mithat Mızrak, Mehmet Ferit Gürsu, Tuğçe Kaymaz, Emir Dönder, Ahmet Yılmaz
pmc-13407423.description: Background/Objectives: This study aimed to evaluate serum fibroblast growth factor-23 (FGF-23) and α-Klotho levels in patients with prolactinoma and patients with non-tumoral hyperprolactinemia and to explore their discriminatory performance for prolactinoma. Methods: Seventy-three participants were included in this single-center, cross-sectional comparative study: non-tumoral hyperprolactinemia (n = 14), prolactinoma (n = 29), and healthy controls (n = 30).

pmc-13522388.title: Demographic, Clinicopathological Characteristics, and Prognosis of 81 Chinese Elderly Patients With Acral Melanoma
pmc-13522388.creator: Kaidi Yang, Xin Cai, Jin Wu, Kui Jiang, Weizhen Zhang, Hongfeng Zhou, Fang Liu, Yan Wang, Jiwei Liu, Di Wu
pmc-13522388.description: PurposeAcral melanoma (AM) is a rare melanoma subtype involving palms, soles, and nail beds. Clinical‐pathological features and survival of elderly AM patients remain insufficiently understood. This study aimed to investigate the characteristics and survival of elderly Chinese AM patients to support clinical management.

pmc-13594594.title: Postnatal phenotypic stability and endocrine homeostasis in Holstein-Friesian heifers conceived via multiple ovulation and embryo transfer vs. artificial insemination
pmc-13594594.creator: Eszter Tóth, János Posta, Gabriella Gulyás, Levente Czeglédi, József Rátky, Renáta Knop
pmc-13594594.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). While Multiple Ovulation and Embryo Transfer (MOET) is a cornerstone for accelerating genetic progress in dairy cattle, empirical data directly comparing the postnatal physiological trajectories of MOET-derived calves against conventional Artificial Insemination (AI) remain limited. This study investigated the growth dynamics, somatotropic axis (GH, IGF-1), metabolic signalling (leptin), and immunological maturation (IgG) of Holstein-Friesian heifers (n = 20) from birth through seven months of age.
